scope: Existing isolated local 8350-game public benchmark through Docker psql; local owner, RLS tested separately in migration replay; OS/cache state uncontrolled; no hosted connection

Plans.Filter: ((NOT explore_early_access) AND (review_count >= 100) AND (COALESCE(release_status, ''::text) <> ALL ('{cancelled,canceled,delisted}'::text[])) AND (COALESCE(release_status, ''::text) <> ALL ('{announced,coming_soon,upcoming,tba}'::text[])))

Plans.Recheck Cond: ((explore_title_key IS NULL) OR (explore_year_suffix IS NULL) OR (explore_franchise_key IS NULL) OR (explore_developer_key IS NULL) OR (explore_publisher_key IS NULL) OR (explore_primary_safe IS NULL) OR (explore_early_access IS NULL) OR (NOT explore_coverable_v1(title, slug, platforms, genres, explore_title_key, explore_franchise_key, explore_developer_key, explore_publisher_key, release_status)))
Plans.Filter:
((release_date <= '2026-11-16'::date) AND (review_count >= 100) AND (COALESCE(release_status, ''::text) <> ALL ('{cancelled,canceled,delisted}'::text[])) AND (COALESCE(release_status, ''::text) <> ALL ('{announced,coming_soon,upcoming,tba}'::text[])) AND COALESCE(explore_primary_safe, ((lower(array_to_string((COALESCE(tags, '{}'::text[]) || COALESCE(genres, '{}'::text[])), '
'::text)) !~ '(sexual content|nsfw|hentai|adult|erotic|nudity|mature-content|sex|porn|mature|adult only|18\+)'::text) AND (lower(COALESCE(description, ''::text)) !~ '(sexual content|nsfw|hentai|erotic|adult-only|explicit sex)'::text) AND (lower(title) !~ '(game of the year edition|goty edition|complete edition|ultimate edition|definitive edition|enhanced edition|digital deluxe edition|deluxe edition|director''?s cut|anniversary edition)$'::text) AND (lower(title) !~ '(?<![a-z0-9_])(season pass|expansion pass|soundtrack|artbook|starter pack|bonus content|cosmetic pack)(?![a-z0-9_])'::text) AND (lower(COALESCE(description, ''::text)) !~ '(?<![a-z0-9_])(you must own the main game|this content requires|downloadable content|expansion pack|includes the following dlc|digital deluxe edition allows access|base game\s*\+\s*(digital deluxe|season pass|art book|soundtrack)|digital art book|extra bgm pack|season pass|second and final expansion|missing link in the main story|bonuses will be given to those who purchase|content can be downloaded from the store)(?![a-z0-9_])'::text))) AND (NOT COALESCE(explore_early_access, EXISTS(SubPlan 1))))

Sort Key: (CASE WHEN (e.steam_app_id = ANY ('{10,80,240,730,4465480}'::integer[])) THEN 'special:counter-strike'::text WHEN (e.year_suffix OR (v.canonical_title IS NOT NULL) OR (e.steam_app_id IS NULL)) THEN ('title:'::text || e.canonical_title) ELSE ('steam:'::text || (e.steam_app_id)::text) END)

Plans.Join Filter: (((v.franchise_key <> ''::text) AND (v.franchise_key = b.franchise_key)) OR ((v.developer_key <> ''::text) AND (v.developer_key = b.developer_key)) OR ((v.publisher_key <> ''::text) AND (v.publisher_key = b.publisher_key)) OR (abs((v.release_date - b.release_date)) <= 730))
